notes.title: Path Notes - v1.4
notes.content:
[u]Fixes[/u]

- Resolved “Missing executable” launch issue. The game now correctly looks for the real file name Case Blind: Stolen Route.exe instead of a non-existent StolenRoute.exe.

- Fixed a startup error that prevented the game from booting for some players due to the above mismatch.

[u]Additions[/u]

- Added 911 radio audio in the outro sequence for extra immersion (and mild panic).

notes.title: Patch Notes – v1.3
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

- Fixed invisible trigger colliders that were blocking interaction with some objects (e.g., water bottle, key items).
- Improved object interaction logic to make gameplay smoother and more responsive.
- ]Minor UI adjustments to make task feedback clearer.
